Blog Touchup

tags: news

Anton

//

16 Jul 2025

Jekyll is a lot of fun, and it’s very easy to find instructions for it. Today I added post navigation and made the posts overall prettier.

Also I made sure all links in my posts are marked ‘nofollow’, not to worsen my google performance score. I also added post default image and next/previous links for easier navigation between posts.

####If you want to learn more I followed these tips:

  • adding attributes to elements with markdown
  • how to link to next/previous on your blog
